first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only running person in this clip, with short dark hair, a dark short-sleeved top, and white shorts. The back of the head, back, and shorts are seen from a low position behind; the legs and feet are mostly outside the frame.

entities.name: passageway surface
entities.identification: The central passageway surface along which Person A travels, paved with light gray panels featuring fine grooves, seams, and dot-like holes, continuously curving into the depth of the image.

entities.name: bulkhead
entities.identification: The light gray-white enclosing bulkheads on both sides of the passageway, featuring panel seams, dark rectangular openings, and built-in facilities.

entities.name: curved structure
entities.identification: The set of large, light-colored arc-shaped components at the upper image-left and image-right, with clearly defined multilayered inner and outer contours.

entities.name: light strip
entities.identification: The continuous blue-white luminous strips arranged along the outer edges of the curved structures and the adjacent bulkheads; the set does not include the small buttons on the control panels.

entities.name: control panel
entities.identification: The set of dark rectangular panels on the bulkheads, beside the desktops, and along the edges of recesses; grouped bright-colored buttons, indicator areas, or display surfaces are visible on the panels.

entities.name: wall niche
entities.identification: The set of bright recessed spaces in the side walls, with white inner walls, rectangular lights, and partial desktops; it is not necessary to infer that they are cabin doors that are opening or closing.

entities.name: bulkhead recess
entities.identification: The set of tall, vertically elongated, rounded-corner recesses on both sides in front of Person A in this clip; within their dark outer edges are elongated light blue-gray inner surfaces, some with a light-colored, pillow-like horizontal section at the top, and small control panels near the edges.
